name: modula3
description: Modula-3: syntax highlighting, and errors, hovers and declarations from the language server of m3j

m3j.home.description: The directory of m3j, with m3_lang_server.jar, m3j.jar and m3build.jar (empty: the environment variable M3J_HOME).

m3j.java.description: The java program (JDK 25 or later) that runs the language server (empty: JAVA_HOME/bin/java, else java from the PATH).

m3j.server.description: Run the language server (errors and warnings, hovers, declarations). Without it there is only syntax highlighting.
